resources.string: Double-encrypt assets/*.lua with AES-256-GCM. Original AndLua layer stays inside. Auto-sign.
Select an AndLua APK to protect.

1. Select APK
2. Protect (only assets/*.lua)
3. Save signed APK

Inner format stays AndLua =IA. Outer layer is ALP2 AES-256-GCM. Runtime gate decrypts on launch so the app still runs.
